notes.title: Version 1.0.1 is now live! (Ooh, our first patch notes! Fun!)
notes.content:
Oh hey there guys. Welcome to our first patch notes!

[h2]V 1.0.1 Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]

✔   Removed Money cap in Chapter 1 Module.
✔   Added ‘International Mode’ dialogue to Chapter 2!
✔   Tweaked & increased frequency of Chapter 4 News Console triggers.
✔   Changed Ch4/5 Autocue dialog visuals for readability.
✔   Changed ‘Exit Game’ to ‘Return to Title’.
✔   Added label to Achievements menu button.
✔   Achievement descriptions now display after game completion.
✔   Lowered overall volume.
✔   Various bugfixes and text / formatting changes.

If you spot any other bugs, or have any other comments you'd like us to know, email [b]hiya@hiddentrack.org.uk[/b]
